visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are seen in a tight, affectionate group hug within a dimly lit restaurant setting. Their facial expressions are filled with genuine joy, characterized by wide smiles and squinted eyes. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, highlighting the glassware and plates on the table in the foreground. (2) The scene transitions through a nostalgic montage of high school photos into a brightly lit, modern living room. A woman wearing a pink cardigan and grey trousers sits on a cream-colored rug, gesturing with her hands while talking excitedly to two friends who are relaxed on a white leather sofa. (3) A close-up focus shot captures a person's hand, adorned with simple rings, reaching out to grasp the black metal handle of a white wooden cabinet drawer. The hand pulls the drawer open smoothly, revealing a glimpse of organized contents inside against the bright indoor light. (4) The woman in the pink cardigan is shown in a close-up, leaning over a light wood table. She uses a grey marker to write on a small white card that features a humorous hand-drawn cartoon. Her focus is intense, and her hand movements are deliberate as she crafts the message. (5) A hand enters the frame to place two small, precisely folded white paper squares onto the wooden tabletop. These notes are positioned next to two distinctive mugs: one featuring a large blue Marimekko-style flower and the other depicting a desert scene with a camel. (6) Back in the spacious living room, the woman playfully tosses the folded notes toward her friends on the sofa. The friends react with loud laughter and immediate engagement, picking up the small papers and beginning to unfold them with expressions of delighted anticipation. (7) The final phase utilizes a slow-motion effect as the two friends read the contents of the notes. Their faces transition from laughter to emotional warmth. A white text overlay appears in the center, framing their reaction as they look down at the papers in their hands.
